acceptanceCriteria.text: Review package generation and manifest validation still fail the workflow on error.
Failure to commit/push the package to `gh-pages` still fails the workflow.
A successful `gh-pages` push followed by bounded HTTP 404/propagation delay does not fail the workflow.
The pending/not-yet-serving state remains visible in logs or the workflow summary.
Tests cover the non-fatal propagation-delay path without weakening actual publication failure handling.

issue.title: fix: do not fail Review Pages CI while GitHub Pages is still propagating
